Name: Kircerise's Portraits for Teddy the Kitten
Author: Kircerise
Description:
[i][size=5]Note: This is a Content Patcher mod, not an replacer.[/size][/i]

[size=5]>>>[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39308]Prince Teddy the Kitten[/url]<<<[/size]


Hello guys. Cats are amazing, aren’t they? Ever since I started playing Stardew Valley, I’ve been searching for cat NPC mods and adding every one I could find to my game.

[i][size=4]But—[/size][/i]

[b][i][size=4]THERE AREN’T ENOUGH!!![/size][/i][/b]

There should be more cats!!! More dogs too!!! Why not?!!!!!!

And just as I was thinking that, this absolutely wonderful, adorable, precious little kitty appeared before me. To put it simply: this kitty is PURRFECT.

LOOK!!! Look at him playing with that toy!!! Look at him sleeping on their back with his belly out!!!

[b]AAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!![/b]

I—I’M—

[b]AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!![/b]

So anyway, I drew a portrait mod for him.
Please enjoyyyyyyyyy!!!!!


I did some test play, but honestly, I'm not even sure if it will launch properly on your end! So if you run into any bugs, please let me know in the comments or via DM! (I know pretty much zero coding, so if you happen to know how to fix it too, that would be a huge help!)


[b][size=5]Installation Guide[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Requirements: Install the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39308?tab=files]Prince Teddy the Kitten[/url]  first.[/*]
[*]Go to the Files page and download the mod via Manual download or Mod manager download.[/*]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI, and here you go![/*]
[/list]
